Then the two entries of the incident record the held area, the right, the scope and the window, and hold nothing else

  Scenario: AC7 The story adds no enforcement, no approval and no version state (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given incident "INC0004521" is opened and closed by "U-8201"
    Then no enforcement, approval or rule-version state is written and no row of role, permission, masking_rule, role_conflict or delegation_limit changes

  Scenario: AC8 A call without a valid credential is answered 401 by each of the three operations (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given incident "INC0004521" is open
    When a caller without a valid credential posts an incident, posts a closure or reads an incident
    Then each answer is 401 and no entry is appended

  Scenario: AC9 A consumed call that fails or does not answer takes no step and appends nothing (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the rwb-case contract mock does not answer the parameters read
    When "U-8201" posts an incident with reference "INC0004521" and one held area "CASE_RECORD" with right "R" and scope "ALL"
    Then the response is 503 with message MSG-P7-003 and no incident exists and no entry is appended
